note: THE RANKING CONSTRAINT this fixture is built around. Set cover is greedy on distinct sessions then rows, so a gate is only OBSERVABLE if the head it refuses is the BEST candidate at the moment it is reached. A 1-token verb head always covers a superset of its own sub-verb heads, so wherever a 1-token head must be refused (ACE_CLASS, HOOK_OWNED, AUTO_MODE_DROP, ASK_DENY_COLLISION) the verb carries TWO sub-verb families and the wider head strictly wins; and wherever a sub-verb head must be PROPOSED, a Stop-refused row sits under the wider head so REFUSED_PROMPT_COLLISION eliminates it first. Without that shape a correct tool could tie-break past the gate under test and the arm would go green having asked nothing.
